FICTIONAL TEST DOCUMENT - Testoprazole is not a real medicine. Used only for automated tests.

Package leaflet: Information for the patient
Testoprazole 20 mg gastro-resistant capsules

1. What Testoprazole is and what it is used for
Testoprazole reduces the amount of acid made in the stomach. It is used to treat heartburn and acid reflux in adults.

2. What you need to know before you take Testoprazole
Do not take Testoprazole if you are allergic to it. Tell your doctor if you have severe kidney disease.
Pregnancy and breast-feeding: ask your doctor or pharmacist for advice before taking this medicine.
Other medicines: Testoprazole may change how the body absorbs iron supplements.

3. How to take Testoprazole
The usual dose is one capsule once a day before breakfast. Swallow the capsule whole with half a glass of water. Do not chew or crush it.

4. Possible side effects
Common side effects: headache, diarrhoea and flatulence.
Rare side effects: blurred vision and hair loss.

5. How to store Testoprazole
Do not store above 30 degrees Celsius. Keep the bottle tightly closed.

6. Contents of the pack and other information
The capsules are white and yellow. Packs of 14 and 28 capsules.
